meta.title: Lenix Wallet | Multi-chain crypto wallet
meta.description: Non-custodial multi-chain wallet para magpadala, tumanggap, mag-swap, at collateral loan — naka-encrypt na local storage at daan sa Lenix recovery kung kailangan.
meta.keywords: Crypto wallet, Multi-chain wallet, Non-custodial wallet, Lenix Wallet, Crypto loan

Hero.subtitle: Non-custodial wallet para sa araw-araw na crypto — naka-encrypt sa device mo, multi-chain by default, at konektado sa Lenix lending at recovery kapag hindi sapat ang karaniwang send.

Features.title: Higit sa storage

encryption.title: Naka-encrypt sa device
encryption.desc: Protektado ang keys ng wallet password at naka-store locally — hindi hawak ng Lenix ang seed phrase o signing keys mo.

loans.title: Collateral loan
loans.desc: Humiram ng stablecoins laban sa supported assets nang hindi ibinebenta ang posisyon — ipinapakita ang terms at collateral ratio bago mag-confirm.

recovery.title: Daan ng recovery
recovery.desc: Kung nawala o ninakaw ang assets, magbukas ng recovery case mula sa Lenix ecosystem — tracing at exchange coordination kapag hindi sapat ang standard wallet flow.

multichain.title: Multi-chain balances
multichain.desc: View assets and history across Ethereum, BNB Chain, and Polygon from one wallet — switch networks without separate apps.

transfers.title: Send, receive, swap
transfers.desc: Move tokens, copy your receive address, and swap supported assets — with buy options where integrated providers are available.

access.title: Web and mobile
access.desc: Use the browser wallet at lenixwallet.com or download the app — create once, import with your recovery phrase on either.

Features.networks_line: Live on Ethereum, BNB Chain, and Polygon.

keys.title: Ikaw ang may keys
keys.desc: Non-custodial by design. Gumagalaw lang ang pondo kapag nag-sign ka — hindi maaaring i-freeze o i-redirect ng Lenix ang balanse ng wallet mo.

storage.title: Naka-encrypt na local storage
storage.desc: Naka-encrypt ang wallet data sa device mo. I-unlock gamit ang password; i-back up ang recovery phrase offline.

access.title: Unlock sa device level
access.desc: Maglagay ng password sa setup at gumamit ng device biometrics kung suportado — dagdag na gate bago gamitin ang keys para mag-sign.

Cta.title: I-download ang Lenix Wallet
Cta.subtitle: Gumawa o mag-import ng wallet sa loob ng ilang minuto. Parehong app para sa send, receive, swap, at loan — may Lenix recovery kapag kailangan mo.

Networks.title: Live on three EVM chains today
Networks.description: Native balances, ERC-20 tokens, and transaction history — filtered by network in the wallet.

GettingStarted.title: Up and running in three steps

create.title: Create or import
create.desc: Generate a new wallet or restore with your 12- or 24-word recovery phrase.

secure.title: Set password and backup
secure.desc: Choose a wallet password and store your recovery phrase offline — Lenix cannot reset it for you.

use.title: Send, swap, or borrow
use.desc: Move assets, review history by chain, or open lending and recovery flows from the Lenix ecosystem.

Ecosystem.title: Wallet connects to the rest of the platform
Ecosystem.description: Hold assets here. When you need more than a transfer, follow the linked workflow.

Trust.text: Smart contract and operational security documentation is published on our Security page.
